title: fix(app-shell): Setup's metadata editor edits views, apps and dashboards as authored, not as translated
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao5ZvZUE3RgkiyeEu1r7wiff)_

Part of #30786: Wanted 1, 2 and 4 for Setup's metadata editor. Wanted 3 (the two plugin-designer pages) is left open for a second PR; the reason is in the report on the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup 元数据编辑器编辑视图、应用、仪表盘（以及服务端会翻译的其它类型）时，可编辑副本改为取分层读取里作者原样存的草稿，不再取按控制台语言翻译过的草稿读取。
- 为什么改：中文控制台里，第一次保存正确，保存后刷新装入的是中文草稿，第二次保存就把中文当成作者原文存了进去，英文用户随后看到中文；在 zh-CN 实测栈上视图、应用、仪表盘三种都复现。
- 风险与回滚：只改客户端读哪一层，不改服务端和协议；服务端不翻译的类型行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`authoredObjectBuffer.ts`（一处读法，按 `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` 判定）、`ResourceEditPage.tsx`（加载、保存后刷新、发布后刷新三处改用它）、测试文件里新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.authoredObjectBuffer-29793.test.tsx`，应见 12 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `e594200c` 的 diff 复核：13 个文件全在 `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` 加根 `.changeset/`，只改客户端读哪一层（按 `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` 判定），对象分支与 Studio 不动；zh-CN 实测栈三种类型复现、`effective` 未翻译；九个旧测试替身补上服务端本就会给的 `draft` 层，断言未改；CI 全绿，Clause-② no，不欠契约复审。Part of #30786：Wanted 3（plugin-designer 两页）走第二个 PR；同类的 Studio 编辑器问题已另立 #30859。同意落地。

## What changes

Setup's metadata editor (`MetadataResourceEditPage`) seeded the edit buffer of every type but `object` from `?state=draft`, which the server translates for the console's `Accept-Language`. PR #30784 had moved only `object` onto the layered read's author-owned layers.

- `authoredObjectBuffer.ts` now holds the one reading for every type whose served reads are translated. `editsAuthoredLayers(type)` asks the spec's `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES`, the same set the REST read translates by, so the client and the server answer "is this read translated" from one source. `authoredBuffer(type, layers, servedDraft)` is the stored `draft` layer as-is, else the published item as authored; a served draft with no `draft` layer is `unserved` (no buffer, nothing sent), as for objects. `authoredPublished(type, layers)` is `overlay ?? code` for an object (its `effective` is governed) and `effective ?? code` for the others, which the layered read serves untranslated. `authoredObjectBuffer` / `authoredPublishedObject` stay as the object's spelling of the same functions, so Studio's object editor (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) is untouched.
- `ResourceEditPage.tsx`: the load, the save refresh and the publish refresh use that reading for those types; reset and discard use `authoredPublished` (byte-identical to the old `effective ?? code` for non-objects). The save refresh now re-reads `/layers` for those types even for a draft-only item, because their buffer is the `draft` layer (the server answers it for a draft-only name to an admitted author).

Wanted 2's three named cases: a flow and a code-defined datasource are not in `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES`, so their editor is unchanged and keeps the server's reading. An orphaned row is never read as `overlay ?? code` here for a non-object type: the published half stays the layered read's own `effective ?? code`, so whatever the server decides `effective` is (orphan included) is what the editor edits, as before.

## Tests

`ResourceEditPage.authoredObjectBuffer-29793.test.tsx` gains a top-level `describe.each` over view, app and dashboard, with zh-CN served drafts shaped as measured below: two edits in a row each PUT source text (the second after the save refresh re-read the draft), a pending draft is edited as stored, and a served draft without its `draft` layer installs nothing.

Nine existing page and report suites (`draftPublishVerdict-26707`, `draftUnreadable-29148`, `draftVersionConflict-11773`, `navigationWrites-28680`, `pageRequiresStamp-11357`, `publishPackageBinding`, `readDecorationStrip`, `servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765`, `serverVerdict-26858`) used client doubles whose `/layers` answer had no `draft` key, so the editor now read their pending draft as unserved. Each double now serves the pending draft as stored beside its readable draft, as the server does for an admitted author; no assertion changed. `readDecorationStrip` keeps both directions: its stored draft and its served (decorated) draft describe the same pending draft, and the undeclared key is still refused by name.

<details><summary>Ablation (head 0ac8ae47)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `authoredObjectBuffer.ts`, anchor `return TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES.has(type);` replaced by `return TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES.has(type) && type === 'object';` (the pre-fix gate): anchor 1 to 0, blob 21daac11d9ea to d754ef68e3a6. Result: `Tests 9 failed | 3 passed (12)`, every view/app/dashboard case red, the three object cases green. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The reading is keyed on the translatable set, so pages, reports, actions, datasets, picklists, positions, permission sets and books take it too. Live-measured beyond the card's three: page, report, action and book reproduce the same way (readings below). Position and permission could not be customised on the stack (a shipped one takes no override), so they are NOT MEASURED live; dataset and picklist were not measured either. They take the same reading because the server translates their served draft by the same predicate.
- Not fixed here, same class, outside this file surface: Studio's editors that seed a buffer from the served draft for these types (for example the app draft in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `StudioNavItemInspector.tsx`, `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx`, `useFormViewDraft.ts`, `StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`), and `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx`, which bases an object parent's save on the served draft or `effective`. Reported to the seat.
- `doc` is not translated by the server's predicate (its read is a locale collapse, ADR-0046), so its editor is unchanged.
- The file keeps its name, `authoredObjectBuffer.ts`, so that Studio's import is not touched by this PR.

## Verification

<details><summary>Wanted 1: live measurement on a zh-CN stack (origin/main 9b24f3ca)</summary>

`pnpm dev -- --fresh` (app-showcase), signed in as the seeded admin, `Accept-Language: zh-CN`, the showcase's customization package ensured (`POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`), every read and write at `?package=com.example.showcase.custom`. The sequence is the editor's: load (`/layers` plus `?state=draft`, 404), PUT 1 of `effective ?? code`, the save refresh, PUT 2 of the buffer the refresh installs today (the served draft).

| type / name | `/layers` at load | PUT 1 body | `?state=draft` after PUT 1 | `/layers` `draft` after PUT 1 | stored draft after PUT 2 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| view `showcase_task.urgent` | `draft: null`, `overlay: null`, `code` = `effective`, label `Urgent` | label `Urgent` | label `紧急` (1 string differs) | label `Urgent` | label `紧急` |
| app `showcase_app` | same shape, label `Showcase` | label `Showcase` | label `功能展示`, navigation `能力地图`, `工作区`, `我的工作`, … (58 strings differ) | source text | label `功能展示`, navigation in Chinese |
| dashboard `showcase_ops_dashboard` | same shape, label `Delivery Operations` | source text | label `交付运营`, widget titles `进行中的项目`, `任务状态分布`, … (16 strings differ) | source text | label `交付运营`, widget titles in Chinese |

All three reproduce. Per type, `/layers` served `draft`, `overlay` and `code`; `effective` equalled `code` (no overlay row), and the served draft and the stored `draft` layer had the same keys, so translation is the only difference. PUT 2 answered `200` with no advisory for these types.

/layers `effective` (zh-CN, at load and after PUT 1): view label `Urgent`; app label `Showcase`, `navigation[0]` `Capability Map`; dashboard label `Delivery Operations`, `widgets[0]` `Active Projects`; equal to `code` in all three; the only CJK string is the app's authored `Command Center (大屏)`, also in `code`. So `effective` is served untranslated and the published half of the buffer stays source text.

Beyond the three, the same sequence (no edit): page `showcase_capability_map` label `Capability Map` served `能力地图`; report `showcase_hours_by_status` label and description translated; action `showcase_mark_done` label and `successMessage` translated; book `showcase_manual` 5 strings translated. Position `manager` and permission `showcase_manager`: PUT refused `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (a shipped one takes no override), not measured.

</details>
